cases.title: Engine checks pass in the monorepo
steps: At the repo root run npm ci, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test
Run npm run build -w graph-execution and node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js --version
Run (cd packages/graph-execution && npm pack --dry-run)
cases.expected: All checks pass (except the known claude-on-PATH cli.test.ts case where a real claude is installed); --version prints 1.2.0; the tarball lists only dist/, skills/, README.md, LICENSE, package.json

cases.title: Login gate
steps: Build and start graph-manager as TESTING.md (graph-manager section) describes
curl /api/health without a cookie
POST /api/auth/login with a wrong then the right password
Open http://127.0.0.1:7420/ in agent-browser and log in
cases.expected: 401 without cookie and for the wrong password; 204 with an HttpOnly cookie for the right one; the UI shows the login page and then the shell with Workspaces, Terminals, Runs, Settings

cases.title: Connect forges with the fake forge
steps: Start the fake forge and graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
On Settings connect GitHub with token gh-good and GitLab with gl-good and the fake base URL
Try a bad token
curl -b cookie /api/forges
cases.expected: Both cards show Connected as octo / gitlab-user; the bad token shows the forge error and is not saved; /api/forges contains no token

cases.title: Clone a workspace
steps: Workspaces → Clone repository → GitHub → search hello → Clone octo/hello
Check <workspaces>/github/octo/hello and git config --get-regexp extraheader there
cases.expected: Row shows branch main and clean; README.md exists; no extraheader in git config; .graph-execution/ is in .git/info/exclude

cases.title: Terminal in a workspace
steps: Click Open terminal on the octo/hello workspace
Type pwd, echo $GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF and graph-execution --version
Reload the page and reopen the terminal
Open a second terminal, type exit
cases.expected: pwd ends with github/octo/hello, handoff prints detached, version prints; output is replayed after reload; the sidebar shows exited 0 for the second terminal

cases.title: Run appears in the dashboard with live view
steps: In the workspace terminal copy packages/graph-execution/src/__fixtures__/diamond and spec.md in, commit, and run graph-execution diamond --spec spec.md --provider fake --web (use GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT with task:4 hang to keep it running)
Open Runs, then the run's detail page
cases.expected: The run is listed within 5 s as running with a live dot; the detail page shows the engine's live graph in the iframe under /runs/<ws>/<id>/view/ with working SSE updates

cases.title: Static graph after the page closes
steps: Let a fake run finish (no hang), press Close in the iframe
Look at the run detail page
cases.expected: Status applied, no live dot; the page shows a layered static graph of the 4 diamond tasks

cases.title: Create PR from an applied run
steps: After a fake run is applied in octo/hello, open its detail page
Press Create PR, keep defaults, Submit
curl http://127.0.0.1:7421/__fake/pulls
cases.expected: A PR link appears; the fake forge lists a pull with head gm/<runId> and base main; the pushed branch has no .graph-execution files

cases.title: Start run button
steps: Runs → Start run, workspace octo/hello, tasks diamond, spec spec.md, provider fake (testing)
cases.expected: The page navigates to the new run, which reaches applied
